rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority opinion narrow, rejecting the Ninth Circuit’s implied “repudiation” requirement and holding the case moot because recurrence is too contingent on genuinely new facts under a practical voluntary-cessation analysis. The dissent is most likely led by Sotomayor (possibly with Thomas and/or Jackson writing separately) emphasizing Laidlaw/City of Mesquite’s heavy burden and the insufficiency of the government’s qualified assurance.
